# TradeScale Plus: AI agents for websites

> TradeScale Plus builds AI agents for websites. An agent knows your website, talks to your visitors and opens your site to ChatGPT and Claude. There are three products: the Car Agent for car dealers, the Property Agent for property agencies (Dubai and UK) and the Custom Website Agent for any other website. Each is added with two lines of code, and nothing else on the site changes.

TradeScale Plus is Trade Scale Plus Ltd, registered in England and Wales, company number 17142290. It was founded by Ashley Evans, who spent 15 years at Citroen, Land Rover and Honda dealers and used car sites, as a salesman and then a sales manager.

## What an agent does

- Answers only from your own website and data.
- Takes visitors to the right page: it drives your website for them, and filters your stock or listings page.
- Compares two or three things side by side, in a wide view.
- Saves a visitor's favourites and keeps their journey: what they looked at.
- Books, or takes the enquiry. Car dealers: viewings and test drives within your opening hours, which you confirm by email. Property and other sites: viewings, or the enquiry.
- Converts prices between currencies at that day's published reference rates, for example AED to USD (property and other sites).
- Checks every reply in code before it is shown. Invented prices, invented cars, wrong links and false claims that something is free are caught and corrected. We say checked, not perfect.

## What the business gets

Enquiries by email, hot-lead alerts, a dashboard of every conversation and of what visitors asked for that was not in stock, and a Monday report.

## The three products

- **Car Agent, for car dealers.** Knows every car in stock, refreshed daily from your own site. Quotes finance at your own published rate. Books viewings and test drives within your opening hours, and you confirm each booking by email. Emails a car's details. From £299 up to £599 a month, depending on stock size; you can start with a free demo built on your own stock. https://tradescaleplus.com/car-dealers
- **Property Agent, for property agencies.** For Dubai and UK agencies. Lists, compares and saves listings, books viewings or takes the enquiry, and converts prices between currencies, for example AED to USD. Pricing is on request. Live demo: TradeScale Property, a sample Dubai agency (https://demo.tradescaleplus.com/homes/tradescale-property). https://tradescaleplus.com/property-agencies
- **Custom Website Agent, for any other website.** Courses, events, services, catalogues: if your visitors come to find things, we can build an agent around your site. Pricing is on request. https://tradescaleplus.com/custom-agents

## The AI door

Some pages are drawn by JavaScript, which ChatGPT cannot normally read. On 1 November 2026 we put our two install lines on a test page built that way. ChatGPT found the live stock on its own, with no setup by the user. Asked "I need a 7 seater under 18,000", it gave all five correct cars and prices, and a follow-up about electric cars returned all three correct. We saw it in our server logs. Claude's reader runs the page and loads the agent itself. It is plain web pages, so any AI that reads the web can use it. There is also an MCP connector for AI apps that take connectors.

This was one test, on a test page we built. It is not a client result and it is not a promise: no one can promise what an AI will recommend, because AI assistants choose their own answers. https://tradescaleplus.com/ai-door

## How it installs

Two lines of code: a link tag (`<link rel="mcp" ...>`) and a script. Nothing else on your site changes. https://tradescaleplus.com/ai-door
